description: Compare internet egress (出网流量/按流量) cost across clouds: the monthly USD cost of sending volume_gb/month to the public internet from a region, tier-accumulated (egress is tiered, so a single $/GB understates it). Egress is often the hidden #1 cost — a cheap server with pricey egress can lose to a pricier one. Filter by provider/region/country/continent/near; returns cheapest regions first. Add to a server's monthly cost for the true bill. Use this for pay-by-traffic; use compare_bandwidth for a fixed Mbps pipe.

continent.description: NA, SA, EU, AS, AF, or OC

country.description: ISO country code, e.g. US, SG

near.description: free-text place to find nearby regions, e.g. Singapore

volume_gb.description: monthly egress to the internet in GB to price (default 1024 = 1 TB)

name: compare_egress
title: Compare internet egress cost
